en: The postcard features a sepia-toned image of a traditional half-timbered house with a sharply sloped roof, which houses a café and confectionery (Konditorei und Kaffee) A. Heringslake. The storefront displays pastries and possibly cakes in its windows. The surrounding street is quiet, with a horse carriage visible to the left and several trees partly framing the scene. The reverse side of the card displays German text, hand-written notes, and a logo featuring a columned structure with the words 'BAD PYRMONT.'
